messages:
sam: Quick check on the 'obsidian' dark console mock. Main items: tiny stacked bars lose separation, syntax tokens don't have enough hue contrast, and the theme toggle copy "Dimmer" is confusing. Screenshot: https://mock.corp/obsidian.png :mag:
rhea: Agree re bars. When multiple series overlap the fills blend into a single blob at small widths. Can we add 1px separation stroke and slightly offset the fill luminance?
tony: For syntax highlighting the blue and teal tokens are very close on our dark bg. Example: `const response = await client.generate()` — the `await` token is almost invisible. Suggest shifting keyword hue to a slightly warmer cyan and increasing saturation of function names.
nina: Copy nit: "Dimmer" reads like brightness control. Recommend "Dark theme" for the toggle and put a separate "Reduced motion / low power" checkbox in Settings -> Accessibility.
sam: On charts I tried moving gradient stop to 28% and adding `stroke: rgba(255,255,255,0.06)` for overlapping areas. That improves micro-contrast without changing overall palette.
rhea: CSS var proposal:
--panel-900: #050611
--panel-800: #0b1220
--code-bg: #0e1724
--code-text: #e8f7ff
--accent-1: #61e6ff
--accent-2: #a78bff
Checked axis labels @13px & most combos hit 4.5:1 except secondary series in stacked bars.
tony: For syntax tokens we could introduce a slight warm shift for keywords (#7edcff -> #8be8ff) and use a muted orange for function names (#ffb86b). That gives clearer semantic color separation.
nina: Also request an Accessibility toggle "High-contrast charts" under Settings (off by default). Useful for customer demos and folks who need stronger separations.
sam: design-bot created a branch `theme/obsidian-contrast` and pushed a storybook entry. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/821 (chart strokes + syntax tweaks). CI: 2 visual snapshots flagged (stacked bars).
design-bot: Added issue GH#921 - "obsidian: stacked bar micro-contrast" and linked PR 821.
rhea: If we keep stacked bars the stroke should be slightly darker than the panel bg (rgba(0,0,0,0.18)) so thin lines remain visible in thumbnails.
tony: Another small UX: token chips within the tokens panel are all same weight. Make the active filter outlined and the rest filled to convey current view.
nina: Copy tweak for tokens panel title: change "Tokens by route" -> "Tokens — by route" (em dash for clarity). Also change the theme tooltip to "Switch between light & dark themes".
sam: Action items: tony to prototype syntax hue shift; rhea to adjust stacked-bar strokes and run visual diffs; nina to update copy strings; sam to merge small story once diffs are green. Aim: deploy to staging tomorrow afternoon.
tony: I'll add the syntax token story to Storybook today. :coffee:
